objectives.statement: Locate each of Liberia's 15 counties on an outline map and name its capital.

standards.statement: Draw the map of Liberia and plot in the tribes according to the political sub-divisions.
Ivory Coast on the East. Counties of Liberia:

objectives.statement: Explain the difference between a county capital (the seat of county administration) and a county's largest or best-known town, and between the national capital and a county capital, using Nimba (Sanniquellie/Ganta) and Montserrado as examples.

standards.statement: Draw the map of Liberia and plot in the tribes according to the political sub-divisions.

objectives.statement: Use a county map to reason about location: name the counties crossed, and the capitals passed, on a route between two county capitals, and justify the answer from the map.

standards.statement: Draw the map of Liberia and plot in the tribes according to the political sub-divisions.
